Why you'll love this role

  • Lead design and delivery from feasibility through to contract administration

  • Registration as an architect in Victoria (or eligibility to register promptly)

  • Advanced Revit skills: worksharing, phasing, families and model management

  • Contract administration experience on public or cultural projects (a plus)
What you'll get
  • Competitive salary + super

job.title: Qualified Maintenance Fitters
job.description:
The Company
We're partnering with an established food processing operation known for its investment in automation, strong safety culture and focus on employee retention. The site runs a modern, high-volume production facility with a reliability-driven maintenance team and a genuine long-term, supportive team culture.
 
Due to continued growth and investment in technology, this site is looking to add experienced Maintenance Fitters to their maintenance team.
 
The Roles
Working closely with the maintenance, production and quality teams, you'll help keep a 24/7 processing facility running safely and efficiently through preventative maintenance, fast breakdown response and continuous improvement.
 
Key responsibilities include:
  • Preventative and breakdown maintenance across processing and packaging equipment
  • Fault finding, diagnostics and mechanical repairs
  • Maintaining conveyors, pumps, gearboxes, bearings, chains, belts, hydraulics and pneumatics
  • Rapid response to mechanical breakdowns in a live production environment
  • Supporting plant upgrades and equipment installations
  • Maintaining equipment in line with HACCP and food safety standards, and wash-down/biosecurity protocols
  • Accurately completing work orders via CMMS and maintaining detailed shift handovers
  • Contributing to safety, quality and continuous improvement initiatives in a fast-paced, temperature-controlled environment
Both Afternoon and Night Shift opportunities are available, generally aligning to approximately 1:00pm-9:00pm and 9:00pm-5:00am (exact times may vary and will be confirmed during recruitment). Shift penalties apply, with overtime opportunities also available.
 
About You
To be successful, you will have:
  • Certificate III in Engineering - Mechanical Trade, Mechanical Fitter qualification or equivalent (essential)
  • Strong mechanical fault-finding and diagnostic experience
  • A proactive, reliable and safety-first approach, with a commitment to food quality standards
  • Full Australian working rights
  • Experience in food manufacturing, meat/poultry processing or FMCG, exposure to automated production systems, wash-down environments, welding/fabrication skills, or a Forklift/EWP licence (highly regarded, not essential)
 
Contact

job.title: Site Manager
job.description:
About the Role

We're seeking an experienced Site Manager to take responsibility of a new-build school construction in Melbourne's western suburbs. The project is already on site and running to a 12-month program, involving suspended slab, steel frame and precast concrete construction.

You'll be the senior on-site presence, supported by a Project Manager and Contract Administrator (part-time on site), a labourer and a floating Safety Advisor. This is a hands-on leadership role for someone who wants ownership of program, productivity and safety without layers of bureaucracy.

Why This Role
  • Step into an active, fully resourced project — no false starts or pre-construction limbo
  • Package up to $180-190K + Super for the right candidate, with a car allowance available
  • Work for a contractor with genuine education-sector depth and a strong Victorian project pipeline
  • Autonomy on site, backed by an established PM/CA structure for support when needed
  • Modern site systems (Hammertech, Visibuild) — no clunky paperwork or outdated processes
  • Clear runway into future education and government-sector projects with the same business
Key Responsibilities
  • Manage day-to-day site operations across a $9-11M new-build school construction
  • Drive program adherence across structural stages including slab, steel frame and precast
  • Own site safety standards and ensure compliance across all trades and activities
  • Coordinate trades, subcontractors and deliveries to maintain productivity targets
  • Liaise directly with the Project Manager, Contract Administrator and client representatives
  • Maintain accurate site records and reporting via Hammertech and Visibuild platforms
Skills & Experience
  • Proven Site Manager experience delivering $8M+ new-build school or education projects
  • VSBA (Victorian School Building Authority) project background essential
  • Confident, professional communicator who builds strong relationships with trades and clients
  • Working knowledge of Hammertech, Visibuild and MS Office
  • Sound understanding of structural methodology — suspended slab, steel frame, precast concrete
  • Current WWCC, White Card and right to work in Australia
About the Company

Our client is an established Victorian construction firm with more than two decades of delivery history across education, government, industrial and community sectors. Pre-qualified for Victorian Government construction up to $50 million, they've built a reputation on reliable, on-time, on-budget delivery rather than competing on price. With a strong education-sector pipeline and a collaborative, low-ego culture, they offer genuine stability and a pathway to further senior site roles.

How to Apply

If you've got runs on the board delivering new-build schools and want to step onto a live, well-resourced project immediately, apply now. For a confidential discussion about the role and the business behind it, contact Alex Clark at Aspect Personnel on 0413 241 783 or via email at a.clark@aspectpersonnel.com.au
